title: Two Stars Collided and Made Gold Worth Ten Earths

scenes.text: Two stars collided and made gold worth at least ten Earths.
On August 17, 2017, astronomers caught two neutron stars crashing together.
Telescopes saw the glow, called a kilonova, in under eleven hours.
Its light showed heavy elements being forged in the blast.
Scientists estimate it made at least ten Earths' worth of gold.
So the gold in a ring was likely made in a crash like this.

description:
Two neutron stars collided 130 million light-years away and made at least ten Earths' worth of gold.
Astronomers caught the blast on August 17, 2017.
Would you wear a ring forged in a star crash?
first_comment: Your gold came from a star crash. What's the coolest space fact you know?
